desc:
Create anything. Destroy everything.

Build with sand, water, wood, metal, explosives, electricity, fire, lava, gases and hundreds of unique materials. Every single pixel is fully simulated with realistic physics, temperature, pressure and chemical reactions.

🔥 Burn forests.
💥 Trigger massive chain explosions.
🌊 Flood entire landscapes.
⚡ Build electrical systems.
🌋 Melt materials with lava.
❄️ Freeze water into ice.
🧪 Discover countless material interactions.

There are no objectives—only your imagination.

Every world is fully interactive and evolves in real time based on your creations.

Can you build something that survives... or destroy everything?
